content.comment_body: Hi, could someone provide a sample program? I want to control an output using a single button that toggles it on and off.
Hello, you can use an impulse relay for this function. Regards,

Hello, I'm facing an issue when implementing this program practically. It works well in simulation, but when I connect the button to the input and link the output to a frequency converter for the motor, the motor doesn't always start or stop with each button press—sometimes I need to press it several times. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users want a simple one-button solution to toggle an output, using a device from [company_name]. Simulations operate as expected, but real-world use shows inconsistent performance when toggling a motor, raising concerns about hardware reliability. Users notice a mismatch between simulation and hardware operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent toggling of the motor each time the button is pressed, with real-world performance matching simulation reliability.
